content.text:
* Current-mirror (symmetrical) OTA, NMOS input, PMOS mirrors B=2.5, cascoded output
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* reference: 10uA enters IBIAS into NMOS diode
XMB0 IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
* tail 36x
XMT ntail IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=45 l=1 m=8
* input pair
XM1 d1 VINN ntail VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=8
XM2 d2 VINP ntail VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=8
* PMOS mirror diodes and 2.5x outputs
XM3 d1 d1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=55 l=0.5 m=2
XM4 d2 d2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=55 l=0.5 m=2
XM5 s5 d1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=55 l=0.5 m=5
XM6 s6 d2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=55 l=0.5 m=5
* PMOS cascodes
XM7 nL vbpc s5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=55 l=0.5 m=5
XM8 VOUT vbpc s6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=55 l=0.5 m=5
* NMOS wide-swing cascode mirror
XM11 nL vbnc s9 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.5 m=5
XM9 s9 nL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.5 m=5
XM12 VOUT vbnc s10 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.5 m=5
XM10 s10 nL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.5 m=5
* bias: PMOS reference diode
XMB1 vbp IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
XMBP0 vbp vbp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
* NMOS cascode bias: Vbnc = VGS + I*Rn
XMBP1 vbnc vbp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
RN vbnc zn 25k
XMBN zn zn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.7 m=1
* PMOS cascode bias: Vbpc = VDD - VSG - I*Rp
XMBPC yp yp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.63 m=1
RP yp vbpc 30k
XMB2 vbpc IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
.ends DUT
